integrity: Mathematical proof with a standalone Python verifier that independently enumerates path families and tests constructive witnesses. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-set and maximal-set enumerations concern only two-row rook graphs; arbitrary rectangular heights are covered only by the packing-number equality. Numerical checks are finite. Priority relative to induced three-vertex-path packing literature remains provisional.
title: Sharp rook-geodesic packings and complete two-row packing polynomials
